page.layout: One column of index entries, running head at top, signature at foot. Letter "S." set apart as a section heading. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Regna omnia evertunt idololatria, tyrannis, & libidinum confusiones. 1.23.
Regna eversa nunquam pristinam dignitatem recuperant. 1.24.
Rerumpublicarum pestes praecipuae: φιλοχρηματία, πολυ-πραγμοσύνη, φιλοζηλία[?], & vindicta cupiditas. 1.22.
Romani Imperii status an Aristocraticus, an Monarchicus. 1.14.
Seditionum initium & progressus. 4.7. flabella. ibid. concitatrix luxuria. 6.5.
Seditiosi & facinorosi mirabiliter à Deo ad supplicia rapiuntur. 1.1.
Seditiosorum subita ruina. ibid. poena & interitus. 4.7.
Sponsaliorum requisita: Consensus nudus, sine vi & metu,
Συγγενῆ[?] brutis quoque insita, nedum hominibus. 5.5.

page.notes: Greek words in the first entry, in "πολυ-πραγμοσύνη" and in "φιλοζηλία", and the reference "1.21", are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The Greek on the last line is also uncertain. The "S." is a section letter set apart, not a heading. The big S of "Sanctitas" is a decorative initial and is written as plain S.
